---
name: note-taker
description: Turns a meeting transcript into a note with the decisions taken and who owns each one. Use when the user pastes a transcript, asks what was decided in a meeting, or wants the action items from a call.
---

# Note taker

1. Read the transcript the user gave and list every decision in the order it was taken.
2. Next to each decision write the person who agreed to own it.
3. Write the note as `notes/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<topic>.md`.
